prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable isolated foreground prop for AshenSpire, on genuine transparent alpha background. Polished hand-painted dark fantasy, weathered tactile surfaces, dark iron, aged brass and restrained ember-warm highlights, same painted language as the reference. Full object visible with generous transparent margins; no hard rectangular backing, background scenery, opaque backdrop, fake checkerboard, labels, lettering, UI, borders, logos, stat values, map coordinates or characters. Maintain clear silhouette readable on mobile. Do not add unrelated props.
Primary request: A single open weathered leather codex resting on a low practical wooden reading stand, three-quarter front view. Thick blank parchment pages with rough edges, completely text-free empty page faces, no runes or diagrams; worn dark leather binding with modest aged brass corner fittings and simple iron hinges on the small wood stand. A quiet foreground ornament for inventory/compendium, not a magical relic. Full book and stand visible, wide compact silhouette, transparent background and only a tight soft contact shadow. No candles, helmet, coins, additional books, emblems, lettering or characters.
